policy: Full cached eligible sample, Galactic extinction corrected (SFD98, configs/extinction_coefficients.json; DESI North->South relation on uncorrected magnitudes), QSO colours unconstrained in magnitude (comparison to the magnitude-independent baseline in configs/unified_full_training.json), frozen fit/select roles, no S/N training cut or row caps. Four independent QSO slice workers plus four cooperating stellar E-step workers; one numerical thread each. Existing component counts and canonical full-data warm starts. MAP covariance update (Bovy et al. 2011 eqs. 19-20, nu=1, w=0.001 mag^2), selected by configs/map_update_test.json. Predictive early stopping: score a fixed role-3 stopping panel every 20 updates, stop when a block gains < 0.02 nats/object, objective tolerance 1e-4, or 300 updates; keep the best checkpoint including the warm start. Stopping panels are excluded from final assessment. Prepare only unless --fit is explicit. Never change active pointer; no downloads. Calibrate rejection after density fitting.
